examples.supported: 2024 UK PRTR is published as downloadable annual facility emissions/waste-transfer data, with CSV and XML resources.
examples.not_supported: No facility row was read in this run; no parcel value may be created.

examples.supported: UK PRTR facilities report releases to air, water and soil and off-site transfers; method semantics and thresholds matter.
examples.not_supported: Register membership does not establish cadastral parcel ownership or a measured GHG row.

examples.supported: Pollution Inventory covers annual mass releases from large regulated industrial sites and includes point and fugitive sources.
examples.not_supported: Permit-wide mass cannot be assigned to one parcel without geometry and scope checks.

examples.supported: Environment Agency publishes annual incinerator monitoring report packages through 2024.
examples.not_supported: Package availability is not a verified extracted pollutant row.

examples.supported: Environment Agency metadata describes annual CO2e emissions from regulated installation operators in England.
examples.not_supported: The XLSX row data was not retrieved in this run, so no operator value was promoted.

examples.supported: Defra metadata confirms an annual CO2e installation dataset extracted from ETSWAP.
examples.not_supported: Metadata alone cannot establish a current parcel-bound installation emission.

examples.supported: March 2026 EPR quarterly data is an effective-installation snapshot with spatial metadata.
examples.not_supported: Permit/site presence is not an emission quantity.

examples.supported: Public Registers Online exposes permit-holder, permit-number, address and document search fields.
examples.not_supported: Searchability does not prove emissions or parcel geometry.

examples.supported: Environment Agency publishes currently authorised landfill site polygons.
examples.not_supported: Landfill boundary polygons do not quantify methane.

examples.supported: Authorised landfill boundaries are available in GeoJSON/GPKG/SHP/WFS-style spatial products.
examples.not_supported: Spatial geometry alone is not a surface-flux measurement.

examples.supported: Landfill guidance requires CH4/CO2 and surface-flux monitoring and representative measurements for capped zones.
examples.not_supported: The guidance threshold is not a specific site's observed flux.

examples.supported: UK ETS installations must monitor emissions and submit verified annual emissions reports.
examples.not_supported: Compliance guidance does not disclose a specific installation's report value.

examples.supported: UK ETS technical collection was updated in 2026 and includes 2026 reporting factors and waste MRV material.
examples.not_supported: Factors/templates cannot replace measured activity data and verified installation scope.

examples.supported: Environment Agency specifies CEMS/DAHS/LTS/PEMS quality standards.
examples.not_supported: Monitoring standards are not emission results.

examples.supported: EN 15259-related guidance defines representative stack measurement locations and sampling strategy.
examples.not_supported: A compliant sampling location does not imply a measured annual mass.

examples.supported: MCP permit guidance was updated 25 March 2026 and includes hydrogen screening/decarbonisation-readiness changes.
examples.not_supported: Permit screening and pollutant limits are not annual GHG observations.
